title: Add ephemeral on-call collaboration mode and sanitized telemetry handoff
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Introduces an ephemeral collaboration mode for on-call responders; adds telemetry snapshot sanitizer and anonymized handoff export; admin controls for TTL and redaction policy; minor UX polish to on-call session UI.
description:
Motivation: On-call war rooms often require short-lived collaborative sessions and sharing slices of telemetry without exposing PII or secrets. This PR implements an ephemeral 'collab mode' for incident-bot sessions plus a telemetry snapshot sanitizer and anonymized handoff export so responders can share contextual artifacts safely during and after an incident.

What this changes: Ephemeral session: a temporary collaboration session is created with a one-time join link and TTL (default 4 hours). Sessions are attached to an incident and support live presence indicators, in-session chat, and a curated artifact list. Telemetry snapshot sanitizer: when a snapshot is captured (logs, traces, metrics window), the sanitizer applies configurable redaction rules (regex, key-wipe, length truncation) and tokenizes high-cardinality identifiers. Handoff export: responders can export an anonymized ZIP (snapshot.json, cleaned traces, brief auto-generated incident notes, action items template) for postmortem or cross-team handoff without leaking sensitive fields.

Security & privacy controls: Admins can toggle redaction policy per-organization and view audit logs for snapshot access. Sessions support immediate revocation and are scoped-to-incident. Default sanitizer rules follow our privacy playbook (remove auth headers, mask email/SSN-like tokens, partial trace IDs).

Developer notes & design choices: Kept sanitizer rules pluggable; default implementation lives in pkg/telemetry/sanitizer.go with an interface for custom rules. Session lifecycle handled in pkg/collab/session.go and persisted to the existing incidents table with a short TTL metadata column. Frontend adds a compact on-call toolbar with 'Start collab session' and 'Capture sanitized snapshot' buttons. Exports are zipped and signed using the platform signing key for integrity.

Testing and rollout: Unit tests for sanitizer rules and session lifecycle included. E2E playbook simulates a small-scale war room. Feature gated behind 'collab_mode' feature flag; rollout plan: internal dogfood -> 10% orgs -> global.

Checklist:
- [x] Feature flag gating
- [x] Unit tests for sanitizer and session store
- [x] Integration test for export ZIP integrity
- [x] Frontend accessibility pass
- [x] Security review and threat model update (SUP-1124)

Related work: ENG-721 (session lifecycles), ENG-734 (privacy sanitize rules).
